main_body: A flat blue-grey metal/panel wall face (sci-fi style) with an orange trim band near the top, riveted panels, two orange shelf bars, a vent grille, and a dark lower skirt. It is a vertical wall face.
top_band: none: rows 0-1 are a light blue-grey cap line, then a dark band; no horizontal surface read as top
evidence: The tile is a wall face drawn flat from the front. A 1-2 row light cap line sits at the top, and the orange band at rows 5-6 is a vertical trim stripe. Panels, rivets, shelves and vent are painted on a vertical face. No top surface is visible. For terrain kind a wall face as front elevation is the expected construction, but strictly there is no 3/4 top band, so it fails the contract.

style.evidence: Candidate wall has large flat areas of one blue-grey tone (panels about 15x10 px) with only sparse rivet dots and a few lighter edge lines. Only about 3 lightness steps in the main material, with an orange trim and shelf accents. The references (timber frame with plaster speckle, stone shaded stone by stone) carry grain, speckle and many more colours per tile. The candidate's tiles are mostly 2-4 colours, so it is clearly thinner and flatter than the reference.
